audience.role: DSH users installing or upgrading the completion Guard; careful upgraders rebuilding the host lock

checks.note: Read the current README reader paths, complete upgrade guide, current compatibility introduction and 0.8.1 change records as user decisions; historical changelog sections retain separate historical scope.

Both languages consistently instruct: stop the host, upgrade and install, inspect/inject/verify each profile, then start it when needed. The upgrade guide gives matching order, backup and supported readback; rebind probes do not boot DSH.
The installed package lock and version floor are introduced before detailed cohort, provenance and qualification terms in references.

Baseline source harness, finite registry/API probes, synthetic future graphs and pending native artifact acceptance are separate. Issued receipts bind program bytes and startup conditions; pnpm installation does not enforce the floor.
Upgrade actions and success signals precede the implementation details. Failure readbacks are separate actionable bullets; 0.8.1 changelog has four observable-change bullets.
Read the English and Chinese introductions, commands, support sections and 0.8.1 entries separately; the version, rebind, native evidence and old-certificate limits agree.

limitations: Six exact-byte documents are bound. This cold reread covers the complete README and upgrade reader paths plus current compatibility and 0.8.1 changelog sections; unchanged historical changelog and deep reference sections are outside this reread.
Final source and archive privacy scans are auxiliary checks recorded separately; they do not establish readability.
